metadata.question: Was the increase in nighttime light intensity from February 21, 2023, to April 30, 2023, greater in Antakya, the capital of Türkiye’s Hatay Province, than in Altınözü?

data.raw_code: The user is asking about comparing nighttime light intensity increases between two locations in Turkey (Antakya and Altınözü) from February 21, 2023, to April 30, 2023. For nighttime lights, the best dataset is VIIRS Day/Night Band (DNB) which provides radiance values. I'll use the VIIRS Stray Light Corrected Nighttime Day/Night Band Composites (VNP46A2) collection. Strategy: 1. Define the two locations as points 2. Get VIIRS data for the two time periods 3. Extract mean radiance values for each location and time period 4. Calculate the increase (difference) for each location 5. Compare which location had greater increase Data quality checks: - Check if collections have images - Check if valid pixels exist after masking - Validate the radiance values are reasonable I need to handle potential cloud masking for VIIRS data, though nighttime lights are less affected by clouds than optical data. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define the two locations const antakya = ee.Geometry.Point([36.2066, 36.1608]); // Antakya coordinates const altinozu = ee.Geometry.Point([36.1167, 36.2333]); // Altınözü coordinates // Buffer the points to get small regions const antakya_region = antakya.buffer(1000); // 1km buffer const altinozu_region = altinozu.buffer(1000); // 1km buffer // Define date ranges const startDate1 = '2023-02-21'; const endDate1 = '2023-02-28'; // Small window around target date const startDate2 = '2023-04-30'; const endDate2 = '2023-05-07'; // Small window around target date // Get VIIRS Nighttime Lights data const viirs = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMCFG'); // Filter for the two periods const period1 = viirs.filterDate(startDate1, endDate1); const period2 = viirs.filterDate(startDate2, endDate2); // Check if collections have data const period1Size = period1.size().getInfo(); const period2Size = period2.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Period 1 (Feb) Images: ${period1Size}`); console.log(`Period 2 (Apr) Images: ${period2Size}`); if (period1Size === 0 || period2Size === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // Get the median composite for each period const img1 = period1.median(); const img2 = period2.median(); // Extract radiance values for both locations const antakya_p1 = img1.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: antakya_region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('avg_rad').getInfo(); const antakya_p2 = img2.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: antakya_region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('avg_rad').getInfo(); const altinozu_p1 = img1.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: altinozu_region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('avg_rad').getInfo(); const altinozu_p2 = img2.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: altinozu_region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('avg_rad').getInfo(); console.log(`Antakya P1: ${antakya_p1?.toFixed(3)}, P2: ${antakya_p2?.toFixed(3)}`); console.log(`Altınözü P1: ${altinozu_p1?.toFixed(3)}, P2: ${altinozu_p2?.toFixed(3)}`); // Check for valid data if (antakya_p1 === null || antakya_p2 === null || altinozu_p1 === null || altinozu_p2 === null) { console.log("C2"); return; } // Calculate increases const antakya_increase = antakya_p2 - antakya_p1; const altinozu_increase = altinozu_p2 - altinozu_p1; console.log(`Antakya Increase: ${antakya_increase?.toFixed(3)}`); console.log(`Altınözü Increase: ${altinozu_increase?.toFixed(3)}`); // Validate values are reasonable (radiance shouldn't be negative or extremely high) if (antakya_increase === null || altinozu_increase === null || Math.abs(antakya_increase) > 100 || Math.abs(altinozu_increase) > 100) { console.log("C3"); return; } // Compare increases if (antakya_increase > altinozu_increase) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
